objections.text: An agent with a shell can widen sharing: share project all --yes runs without a person, and the env file can be written directly. The confirmation protects a person at a terminal, not against a process; part 1 named agent shell access as the guarantee's boundary, and here it decides what may leave. Every change is logged with its source and share status prints the last one; the ADR says so.

A restore changes the person's choices: the levels in the copy are reset to Nothing on purpose, so a copy taken under a wider policy never re-grants it; the roots and areas in the env file keep their current values. The CLI and the viewer say what was reset and it is logged with source restore; a person who restores sets the levels again.

The settings rule that the environment wins over the file gains two exceptions, the sharing keys, where the environment can only narrow; the Settings page's footer states the rule without them. The footer is reworded in this part and the ADR records the exception; a reader of src/settings/settings.ts meets one special case.

Memories have no area: a project at Knowledge and memories sends every memory of the fixed set whatever the area list says, so a private area protects knowledge only. The Sharing page and the project dock say it in plain words and the ADR records it; a filter by memory kind is a later item if the team asks.
